sections.text: A conditional planning estimate is available. It depends on the accepted assumptions and is not a guarantee of production performance. This is a planning picture for discussion, not a promise that the factory will perform as hoped. Treat it as a checkpoint before committing to build or purchase.

The workload estimate is 8 GPUs. The selected factory deployment anchor is 256 GPUs. These are different quantities. HGX_B300: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_B200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_H200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). Counts use whole GPU nodes. Spare compute does not establish an admitted tenant count. Sensitivity is not a confidence interval. The estimate shows processing capacity the work needs, while the saved design shows the factory size under consideration. Spare space is a buffer for later choices, not proof outside users are ready to share.

Required memory per GPU: 58.359738 GB. Selected hardware memory per GPU: 288 GB. Host RAM provision for the workload: 2048 GB. Host local disk provision: 30720 GB. Host provisions are planning assumptions. Per-device memory fit matters, not just aggregate memory. This explains working memory for active tasks and storage held on the host for immediate use. It matters because each device must have enough room for its own work, not merely a large total.

No local shared-storage capacity has been established. This is not a zero-storage requirement. An outside corpus is not automatically copied into this factory. Shared files kept for later have not been sized yet, and that gap is a requirement to resolve rather than an empty need. Outside data is not assumed to appear inside the factory automatically.

External customer datacenter ingress: unresolved. North-south ingress: unresolved. Dedicated storage read/write links: unresolved / unresolved. East-west link per GPU: unresolved. Storage networking is physically dedicated, not converged. External and north-south rates describe the same traffic at different boundaries and must not be added together. These are lower bounds, not selected circuit sizes. These open items describe traffic entering the factory and communication between GPUs. They need agreement with the architect, and unresolved needs are not empty needs but differ from design choices the architect must make.

Review assumptions and outstanding measurements with the architect. Prepare or use the saved design handoff together with its companion requirements. Provide the initial customer-datacenter data volume and allowed transfer window. Ongoing bulk transfers are unspecified. Daily-volume rates are averages over 24 hours, not measured burst rates. Measure aggregate storage read and write throughput. Storage capacity alone does not determine fabric bandwidth. East-west per-GPU port demand needs the selected reference design and collective-communication measurements. Customer-datacenter round-trip latency objective is unspecified. A saved projection exists. Fields marked brief_only must be applied separately by the architect. Use the saved handoff with its companion requirements when reviewing choices with the architect. Supply the missing transfer details and measurements so the design can be checked again.
